title: AZURE DASH
oneLiner: Race the coast and ridge: build speed, roll the loop, collect rings and reach both flags.
mechanics: Accelerate, skid, reverse and backtrack through two authored acts.
Slope momentum and rolling retain speed; down+B charges a release dash.
Variable jump height, springs, elevated routes and a traversable momentum loop.
Rings scatter on damage and can be recovered during invulnerability; empty-ring hits cost a life.
Checkpoints restore progress after a fall; each act has a visible finish flag.
Two players race independently in stacked views; first to finish both acts wins.

controls.down: Roll / hold with B to charge
controls.b: Roll; down+B charge, release to dash

lose: Run out of three lives; falls restart at the last checkpoint.
scoring: 10 per ring, 100 per enemy or checkpoint, act-clear ring and time bonuses.
note: Original Azure Hare character and levels, inspired by momentum platformer mechanics.
